name: Cryptid

categories.label: Found the cryptid's habitat
categories.labelVi: Tìm đúng môi trường sống của Cryptid
categories.hint: Winner searches the habitat space and no other player places a cube on it

endCondition.description: Game ends immediately when a player searches the space containing the habitat and no other player places a cube on it

winCondition: First player to search the exact space where the cryptid lives, with no other player able to place a cube there, wins. Players then compare clues to verify. No points and no ties.
notes: family: deduction. No points; record only the winner. Each player holds a private clue; setup is by player count (3-5) via setup booklet. Verified only against a third-party rules summary, not the official rulebook PDF (not retrievable in this session).
